newsitem.title: USA: Miami auditor says city bookkeeping is unreliable.
newsitem.headline: Miami auditor says city bookkeeping is unreliable.

text.p: Miami's external auditor, KPMG Peat Marwick, severely criticized the city's bookkeeping, saying the city had not reconciled its accounts for months.
"The completeness, accuracy and integrity of the city's accounting records cannot be relied upon by management to make informed financial and operating decisions," the CPA firm stated in a report.

The report was issued late Monday as city officials prepared for a Tuesday morning meeting to make a report to a state-appointed oversight board showing how actual revenues and expenditures matched up with estimates.
Last week, the oversight board approved the city's plan aimed at closing a budget deficit estimated at $68 million.
